title: At, in and on: prepositions of place
summary: Тонкости предлогов места at, in и on: точка, пространство и поверхность; at / in / on с зданиями, городами, транспортом, страницами и СМИ; различия британского и американского английского.
ru:
## Базовая логика: точка, пространство, поверхность
На русском для всего этого часто хватает «в» и «на», поэтому выбор между тремя английскими предлогами — частая трудность.
- **at** — **точка** на карте или «пункт» (мы думаем о месте как об ориентире): at the bus stop, at the door, at the entrance, at the end of the road.
- **in** — **замкнутое пространство** или область: in a room, in a box, in a city, in the garden, in the sky.
- **on** — **поверхность** или линия: on the wall, on the ceiling, on the floor, on the river (о городе у реки), on the coast, on page 5.
> We waited for her **at** the bus stop. — Мы ждали её на остановке.
> The keys are **in** the drawer. — Ключи в ящике.
> A fly is sitting **on** the ceiling. — Муха сидит на потолке.

## Здания и учреждения: at (функция) и in (внутри)
**At** говорит о том, **что человек там делает** (учится, работает, смотрит): at school, at work, at the dentist's, at a concert, at a conference, at the university. **In** подчёркивает, что человек **внутри здания**: *There's a café in the hospital.* — В больнице есть кафе.
> She is studying **at** the University of Leeds. — Она учится в Лидском университете.
> My grandfather is **in** hospital. (BrE) / **in the** hospital. (AmE) — Дед в больнице (как пациент).
Похожие пары: **in prison / in jail**, **in bed**, **at home**, **at sea** (в плавании) — **on the sea** (на побережье, на поверхности).

## Города и страны: in, но at на маршруте
О том, где человек живёт или находится, говорим **in**: *He lives **in** Bristol.* Если место — просто промежуточная точка маршрута, подходит **at**: *We changed trains **at** Crewe.* / *The plane stopped **at** Singapore.*

## corner, end, top, front
- **in the corner** of a room — внутри; **on the corner** of a street — на пересечении; **at the corner** — рядом с углом: *The lamp is **in** the corner of the room. / The shop is **on** the corner of Elm Street.*
- **at the end of the corridor** (точка в конце) — но **in the end** значит «в конце концов».
- **at the top / bottom** of the page, stairs; **on top of** — поверх: *the book on top of the pile.*
- **at the front / back of** + здание, очередь, класс: *He stood **at the front** of the queue.* **In the front / back of** + машина, такси (внутри): *The children sat **in the back** of the car.*

## Транспорт и этажи
**on** — большой общественный транспорт, на который «входят»: on the bus, on the train, on a plane, on a ship, on a bike. **In** — малый, закрытый: in a car, in a taxi. **On the third floor** — этаж; **on the left / right**; **on an island**; **on a farm**.
> I'm afraid I left my gloves **on** the bus. — Боюсь, я оставил перчатки в автобусе.

## Тексты, СМИ, изображения
**in** the newspaper, in a book, in the first paragraph, in a photo / picture, in the sky; **on** page 45, on the screen, on TV, on the radio, on the internet.
> The answer is **on** page 45, in the second paragraph.

## Британский и американский варианты
- **in the street** (BrE) — **on the street** (AmE).
- **in hospital** (BrE) — **in the hospital** (AmE).
- **in a team** (BrE) — **on a team** (AmE).
- **at the weekend** (BrE) — **on the weekend** (AmE) — это время, но тоже разница.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She works on a bank.~~ → She works **at / in** a bank.
- ~~I read it on the newspaper.~~ → I read it **in** the newspaper.
- ~~He lives at Bristol.~~ → He lives **in** Bristol.
- ~~The hotel is in the corner of Oxford Street.~~ → on the corner of Oxford Street.
en:
## The basic idea: point, space, surface
Choosing between **at, in** and **on** is often difficult for learners whose language uses fewer prepositions.
- **at** = a **point** or a reference position: at the bus stop, at the door, at the entrance, at the end of the road.
- **in** = an **enclosed space** or area: in a room, in a box, in a city, in the garden, in the sky.
- **on** = a **surface** or line: on the wall, on the ceiling, on the floor, on the coast, on page 5.
> We waited for her **at** the bus stop.
> The keys are **in** the drawer.
> A fly is sitting **on** the ceiling.

## Buildings and institutions: at (function) and in (inside)
**At** says **what someone is doing there** (studying, working, watching): at school, at work, at the dentist's, at a concert, at a conference, at the university. **In** stresses being **inside the building**: *There's a café in the hospital.*
> She is studying **at** the University of Leeds.
> My grandfather is **in** hospital. (BrE) / **in the** hospital. (AmE)
Similar: **in prison / in jail**, **in bed**, **at home**, **at sea** (travelling) — **on the sea** (by the coast, on its surface).

## Cities and countries: in, but at on a route
For where someone lives or is, use **in**: *He lives **in** Bristol.* When a place is just a stop on a journey, **at** is possible: *We changed trains **at** Crewe.* / *The plane stopped **at** Singapore.*

## corner, end, top, front
- **in the corner** of a room (inside); **on the corner** of a street; **at the corner** (near it): *The lamp is **in** the corner of the room. / The shop is **on** the corner of Elm Street.*
- **at the end of the corridor** (a point), but **in the end** means 'finally'.
- **at the top / bottom** of the page or stairs; **on top of** = above and touching.
- **at the front / back of** a building, queue or class: *He stood **at the front** of the queue.* **In the front / back of** a car or taxi: *The children sat **in the back** of the car.*

## Transport and floors
**on** a bus, train, plane, ship, bike (large vehicles you get on); **in** a car, taxi (small, enclosed). **On the third floor**, **on the left / right**, **on an island**, **on a farm**.
> I'm afraid I left my gloves **on** the bus.

## Texts, media and images
**in** the newspaper, in a book, in the first paragraph, in a photo / picture, in the sky; **on** page 45, on the screen, on TV, on the radio, on the internet.
> The answer is **on** page 45, in the second paragraph.

## British and American English
- **in the street** (BrE) — **on the street** (AmE).
- **in hospital** (BrE) — **in the hospital** (AmE).
- **in a team** (BrE) — **on a team** (AmE).

## Common mistakes
- ~~She works on a bank.~~ → She works **at / in** a bank.
- ~~I read it on the newspaper.~~ → I read it **in** the newspaper.
- ~~He lives at Bristol.~~ → He lives **in** Bristol.
- ~~The hotel is in the corner of Oxford Street.~~ → on the corner of Oxford Street.
structure:
## at / in / on
| Предлог | Образ | Примеры |
|---|---|---|
| at | точка, пункт, функция места | at the door, at the bus stop, at school, at a concert, at the top of the page |
| in | пространство внутри, область | in a room, in a city, in the sky, in a photo, in the newspaper |
| on | поверхность, линия, этаж | on the wall, on the floor, on page 5, on the coast, on the third floor |

## Транспорт
| Предлог | Транспорт |
|---|---|
| on | bus, train, plane, ship, bike, ferry |
| in | car, taxi, lorry, helicopter |

## Пары, которые легко спутать
| Конструкция | Значение |
|---|---|
| in the corner (of a room) / on the corner (of a street) | внутри / на пересечении |
| at the front of the queue / in the front of the car | в начале очереди / в передней части салона |
| at the end of the road / in the end | в конце дороги / в конце концов |
| at sea / on the sea | в плавании / на море, на берегу |
| in hospital (BrE) / in the hospital (AmE) | пациентом |

## Запомните
- **in** + город, страна, замкнутое пространство; **at** + пункт на маршруте.
- **in the street** (BrE) = **on the street** (AmE).

exercises.title: at, in или on?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте at, in или on (если допустимо несколько вариантов — достаточно одного).
exercises.example: We waited for her ___ the bus stop. → **at**

items.text: We waited for her {{at}} the bus stop.
A fly is sitting {{on}} the ceiling.
She is studying {{at}} the University of Leeds.
My grandfather is {{in}} hospital after a fall.
Their office is {{on}} the third floor.
Their shop is {{on}} the corner of Main Street and Elm Road.
The children sat {{in}} the back of the car.
There was a long queue {{at}} the entrance.
She lives {{in}} a small village {{on}} the coast.
I read about the accident {{in}} the newspaper.
We watched an interesting documentary {{on}} TV last night.
There's a spelling mistake {{in}} the first paragraph.
We spent a week {{on}} a small island in Greece.
He was standing {{at}} the front of the queue.
We met {{at}} a conference in Lisbon.

items.q: The picture is hanging ___ the wall.
The lamp is ___ the corner of the room.
items.why: Угол комнаты — внутреннее пространство: **in the corner**.

items.q: There's a pub ___ the end of the road.
items.why: Точка в конце дороги — **at the end of**.

items.q: They've been ___ sea for three weeks.
Let's talk about this ___ the car.
items.why: Машина — малый закрытый транспорт: **in the car**.

items.q: I'm afraid I left my gloves ___ the bus.

options: She works at a bank in London.
She works on a bank in London.
She works at a bank at London.

items.why: Пациент в больнице — **in hospital** (BrE) / in the hospital (AmE).

options: The shop is on the corner of Elm Street.
The shop is in the corner of Elm Street.
The shop is at corner of Elm Street.
items.why: Угол улицы — **on the corner**; in the corner — угол комнаты.

options: I saw it in the newspaper.
I saw it on the newspaper.
I saw it at the newspaper.
They stayed in a small hotel on the island.
They stayed in a small hotel in the island.
They stayed at a small hotel at the island.
items.why: Остров — **on an island**; отель — in / at a hotel.

exercises.title: Переведите на английский
exercises.instruction: Переведите предложение, используя подсказку в скобках.

items.prompt: Мы встретились на конференции в Лиссабоне. (met / conference / Lisbon)
answers: We met at a conference in Lisbon.
We met at the conference in Lisbon.
My grandfather is in hospital.
My grandfather is in the hospital.
My grandfather's in hospital.
My grandfather's in the hospital.

items.prompt: Их офис на третьем этаже. (office / floor)
answers: Their office is on the third floor.
Their office is on the 3rd floor.
The answer is on page 45.
The answer is on page forty-five.

items.prompt: Он стоял в начале очереди. (stood / front / queue)
answers: He stood at the front of the queue.
He was standing at the front of the queue.
He was at the front of the queue.
He stood at the front of the line.
He was standing at the front of the line.
He was at the front of the line.

items.prompt: Мы провели неделю на маленьком острове. (spent / week / island)
answers: We spent a week on a small island.
We spent one week on a small island.

exercises.title: Исправьте ошибки
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение без ошибок в предлогах.

items.prompt: She is studying in the University of Leeds.
answers: She is studying at the University of Leeds.

items.prompt: I read it on the newspaper.
answers: I read it in the newspaper.
He lives in Bristol.

items.prompt: There is a mistake on the second paragraph.
answers: There is a mistake in the second paragraph.

items.prompt: The hotel is in the corner of Oxford Street.
answers: The hotel is on the corner of Oxford Street.

items.prompt: I left my bag in the bus.
answers: I left my bag on the bus.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, следя за предлогами at, in, on.

items.prompt: Where do you work or study? Describe the place and the floor.
items.sample: I work at a design studio in the city centre, on the fourth floor.

items.prompt: Where do you usually wait for public transport?
items.sample: I usually wait at the bus stop opposite my house.

items.prompt: Where do you usually read the news?
items.sample: I read the news on my phone, and sometimes in the newspaper at the café.

items.prompt: Describe where something is in your room (on the wall, in the corner, on the shelf).
items.sample: There is a lamp in the corner and a poster on the wall above my desk.
